$comment: CF2A-01 pass-7 Wave 1 · executable acceptance criterion (P7-06). Closed: every property is declared. The executable fields are the only ones a runner may consult; `description` is a projection and never qualifies a task.
title: cf.criterion.v1

argv.description: Program and arguments, no shell. A criterion whose argv is empty is not executable and MUST be refused.

oracle_digest.description: Digest of the expected output bytes when the criterion compares output. Optional: an exit-code criterion omits it.
